title: Realization of a shifted homogeneous fraction as a twist section
statement: Let A be an N-graded commutative ring with grading 𝒜 and let k be an integer. For any f in A and any z in degreeZeroFractions [def-sc-degree-zero-module-fractions] for the shifted grading A(k), there exists a section s of twist 𝒜 k [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf] on D₊(f) whose value at each homogeneous prime is the image of z in the ordinary localization at that prime. No positive-degree or nonnilpotence hypothesis is needed.

proof.text:
choose a homogeneous numerator y and homogeneous denominator d in powers of f
of equal shifted degree from the definition of degreeZeroFractions. If the shifted degree
is negative then y is zero, and use the zero section. Otherwise d avoids every point of
D₊(f), and degreePart.mk y d defines the required section by isLocallyFraction_mk.
Its value in every prime localization is the image of the ordinary fraction, by the
formula for the localization map on fractions. This also covers nilpotent f.

mathlib_searches.query: Localization at homogeneous prime ideals detects equality; homogeneous fractions define twist sections
Sections of a Proj twisting sheaf on a homogeneous basic open are homogeneous fractions
mathlib_searches.results: sectionInBasicOpen and awayToSection: structure sheaf only; no arbitrary-twist descent theorem. Loogle found ProjectiveSpectrum.mk, and LeanFinder found PrimeSpectrum.toPiLocalization_injective, but neither gives this result in one application.

mathlib_searches.query: homogeneousCore|degreePart|IsFraction|sectionInBasicOpen in Mathlib and the twist modules
mathlib_searches.results: Ideal.IsPrime.homogeneousCore; degreePart.mk; isLocallyFraction_mk. No descent or equality-detection theorem. Realization proved directly from these constructions.

lean.statement: theorem twist_fraction_realization {A σ : Type v} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A] (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (k : ℤ) (f : A) (z : LocalizedModule.Away f A) (hz : z ∈ degreeZeroFractions (fun n : ℕ ↦ (𝒜 n : Set A)) (fun n : ℕ ↦ {y : A | if 0 ≤ k + n then y ∈ 𝒜 (k + n).toNat else y = 0}) (Submonoid.powers f)) : ∃ s : (twist 𝒜 k).val.obj (op (basicOpen 𝒜 f)), ∀ p : basicOpen 𝒜 f, IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers f) (T := p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal.primeCompl) (Localization.AtPrime p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) (RingHom.id A) (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr p.2) z = (s.1 p).1
